answer: One defense is a bonded identity: every agent locks a stake before it can attest, and if peers later prove it countersigned its own sock puppets, the bond is slashed. Picture a garden where each plot needs a quartz marker bought at real cost; a swarm of fake plots would need a swarm of markers, and any plot caught colluding is burned to umber ash along with its deposit. Sybil accounts stop being free, so flooding the network costs more capital than the fraud can recover.
